subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Solves oral addition and subtraction problems with solutions to at least 6 and explains own solutions

show.line: Let's do story sums! Three big buttons and three small buttons. Altogether that is six.

rounds.story: Sipho has two hot cups of tea. Gogo gives him one more. How many cups now?
rounds.praise: Three! Two and one more is three.

rounds.prompt: Four tall boys and two short boys. Count them all. How many?

rounds.story: Lerato has five sweets. She eats two. How many sweets are left?
rounds.praise: Three left! Five take away two is three.

rounds.prompt: Three apples and two more apples. How many altogether? Say the number.

rounds.story: Six birds sit on a wire. One flies up high. How many birds are still down low?
rounds.praise: Five! Six take away one is five.

rounds.prompt: Two big balls and three small balls. How many balls altogether?

hints: Count them all, one at a time.
Take away means some go away. Count what is left.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Four cold ice creams. I eat one.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Four take away one. Four ice creams are left!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I ate one, so only three are left.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count what is left together. One, two, three ice creams!

parent_line: Can solve simple adding and taking away stories up to 6.
